item.title: Babcock hosts engineering festival for future engineers
item.description: More than 400 pupils and teachers from across Bristol and the South West took part in engineering and technology activities this week as part of Babcock’s national Festival of Engineering. The two-day event, held in Bristol to coincide with World Engineering Day on 4 March, forms part of a wider series of events also taking […] The post Babcock hosts engineering festival for future engineers first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: RAF rules out F-35 reservist pilot scheme
item.description: The Royal Air Force has assessed the possibility of allowing reservist pilots to operate F-35 fighter jets but concluded that such a model is not suitable for the UK at present, the Ministry of Defence said. The post RAF rules out F-35 reservist pilot scheme first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK airborne forces deepen US and French ties
item.description: 16 Air Assault Brigade continues to strengthen interoperability with the US 82nd Airborne Division and France's 11e Brigade Parachutiste through a series of exercises and exchanges. The post UK airborne forces deepen US and French ties first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Minister says defence investment plan will be published when ready
item.description: A defence minister has said the Government will publish its Defence Investment Plan once it is complete, arguing that major spending decisions are already being taken. The post Minister says defence investment plan will be published when ready first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy seeks rapid counter-drone capability for ships
item.description: The Royal Navy is exploring the rapid procurement of a maritime counter-drone capability under a new pre-procurement initiative known as Project TALON. The post Royal Navy seeks rapid counter-drone capability for ships first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Decision on new low-cost air defence missile yet to be made
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said a decision on whether the UK will procure a proposed new low-cost air defence missile has not yet been taken. The post Decision on new low-cost air defence missile yet to be made first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Families moved away from RAF Akrotiri on Cyprus
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said non-essential personnel and families at RAF Akrotiri in Cyprus have been relocated to temporary accommodation elsewhere on the island as part of measures to strengthen security at the base. The post Families moved away from RAF Akrotiri on Cyprus first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK remains committed to landmine ban treaty
item.description: The UK Government has reaffirmed its commitment to the Ottawa Convention banning anti-personnel landmines despite recent withdrawals. The post UK remains committed to landmine ban treaty first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American forces strike Iranian drone carrier
item.description: American forces struck an Iranian vessel described as a drone carrier during ongoing military operations in the region, leaving the ship ablaze. The post American forces strike Iranian drone carrier first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: More than 30 Iranian naval vessels destroyed
item.description: US forces have destroyed more than 30 Iranian naval vessels since the start of the current military campaign. The post More than 30 Iranian naval vessels destroyed first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
